name: bn10
description: BitNode 10: Covenant route config, plus the bn15 darknet family (The Red Pill can come from the 4th lab in BN10) and the shared sleeves layer.
notes: Extends bn15 for the darknet scripts and dnet_root.js; bn10 config overrides bn15 BN15-tuned player_activity_config.json with the neutral one. Sleeve scripts come from the sleeves layer; startup order is unchanged (dnet_root.js, sleeve_controller.js, sleeve_buyer.js, allocator.js). sleeve_buyer.js (startup) buys sleeve augmentations at once and Covenant sleeves and memory after joining; set covenantTarget true near 20 installs. graft_controller.js (startup since 2026-11-18 22:20; live grafting, Ken approved 2026-11-18). allocator.js (startup, about 4.5GB) is the shadow allocator: it values purchases and logs verdicts, buys nothing (docs/allocator-design.md R1).
